verdict.rationale: The docs cover local-currency settlement: payouts in 24+ currencies, smart routing to the domestic rail when currency and country match, and embedded FX conversion. Nothing in the pack documents supported onboarding countries or local payment methods, and nothing shows a consolidated coverage map, so the story is only glancingly met. Missing for 10: a documented list or map of supported onboarding countries, a per-country catalog of local payment methods, a consolidated coverage map tying countries, methods and settlement currencies together, and independent corroboration.
